title_en: Extension of the Research Ethics Training Period for Graduate Students, Fall Semester (2nd Semester) 2026 (until October 31)
summary: The enrolment period for the 2026 2nd-semester online research ethics training for graduate students has been extended to Saturday, 31 October 2026. Graduate students who have not yet completed the training should take it within this period.
applies_to: Graduate students who have not yet completed the training, namely new graduate students entering in the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year, and enrolled students who have not completed the research ethics course or the online training. Graduate students participating in BK21 may take the course until December 2026.

dates.what: Extended deadline for completing the online research ethics training
Deadline for graduate students participating in BK21

steps: Click 'SNUON-Course List' ('SNUON-강좌목록') on the left side of the screen.
Register for the course that matches your field (Humanities and Social Sciences, or Science and Engineering), in Korean or English.
Watch 100% of all videos and download and view the learning materials (PDF) to have completion recognised, by Saturday, 31 October 2026 (BK21 participants: by December 2026).
After completing the course, print your certificate of completion yourself.
translation:
Extension of the Research Ethics Training Period for Graduate Students, 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year (until October 31)

The enrolment period for the online research ethics training for graduate students for the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year has been extended to Saturday, 31 October 2026 (2026. 10. 31.(토)). Graduate students who have not yet completed the training are asked to take it within this period.

A. Course titles
- 2026-2) Research Ethics for Graduate Students (Humanities and Social Sciences / Science and Engineering) [2026-2) 대학원생을 위한 연구윤리(인문사회계 / 이공계)]
- 2026-2) Research ethics for graduate students (Humanities and Social Sciences / Science and Engineering)

B. Who must take the course
- New graduate students entering in the 2nd semester of the 2026 academic year
- Enrolled students who have not completed the research ethics course (교과목) or the online training

C. Course period: Tuesday, 1 September to Saturday, 31 October 2026 (2026. 9. 1.(화)~10. 31.(토))
※ Graduate students participating in BK21 may take the course until December 2026.

D. How to take the course
- Log in to eTL (https://etl.snu.ac.kr) → click 'SNUON-Course List' ['SNUON-강좌목록'] on the left → search for 'Research Ethics' ['연구윤리 / Ethics'] → register for the course that matches your field → take the course.
※ Completion is recognised when you have watched 100% of all videos and downloaded and viewed the learning materials (PDF). After completing the course, you can print your certificate of completion yourself.

Attachment: Guide to the Research Ethics Training for Graduate Students, 2nd Semester of the 2026 Academic Year (Korean and English), one copy each.

Attached files (2):
- 2026 2nd-Semester Research Ethics course sign-up Guide for Graduate Students.pdf
- 2026학년도 2학기 대학원생 연구윤리 교육 수강 안내.pdf (Korean version of the guide)

Note from the translator: The contents of the attached PDF files were not included in the notice text and have not been read or translated. Please download them from the original notice. For questions, contact the department office; contact details, if any, are in the original notice.
